methods.name: ADD THE POINTS AT INFINITY
methods.outcome: Infinitesimal bounded-degree positive factors converge locally uniformly to exp(sum c_r z^r), whose normalized form is compound-Poisson.

methods.name: SWAP THE QUANTIFIERS
methods.outcome: For every finite graded pair with positive-factorization width of its spectral-energy polynomial at most D, bounded degree-D LDA implies bounded full chi-square and a uniform TV gap; no necessity/maximality claim.

methods.name: FIND THE EXTREMAL OBJECT
methods.outcome: At fixed primitive mass profile C_r, the sharp compactified envelope is exp(sum C_r q^r), approached by products (1+C_r z^r/m)^m.

new_core_results: Define F_{P,Q}(z)=1+sum_j ||Pi_j(L-1)||_2^2 z^j. Then Adv^{<=D}(P,Q)^2=sum_{j<=D}b_j and 1+chi2(T_{sqrt(q)}P||Q)=F_{P,Q}(q).
If normalized F_{P,Q} is Hurwitz stable, Klich 2026 Corollary 4.4 implies w_+(F)<=2, hence the full pre-noise chi-square bound for every D>=2.
Mao's exact zero-LDA window forces w_+(F_n)>D_n, so his counterexample is excluded by a high-degree positive-atom/reassembly obstruction rather than by naming rank tests.
Infinitesimal width-R positive factorizations compactify to compound-Poisson spectral-energy entire functions.
